sources.title: Qwen3-32B-AWQ — specs, VRAM, license, benchmarks | LocalLLMs
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen/Qwen3-32B-AWQ is a 32-billion parameter large language model developed by Alibaba's Qwen research team, released in 2025 as part of the Qwen3 model family. It uses Activation-aware Weight Quantization to reduce the memory footprint of the base Qwen3-32B model while maintaining most of its capabilities. sources.title: Qwen3-32B-AWQ: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3-32B-AWQ is a 32.8 billion parameter causal language model from Qwen with unique dual-mode reasoning capabilities.
